title: auto-man cross-run ledger entry (~/.claude/auto-man/ledger.jsonl)
description: One line per completed run, across ALL projects on this machine — the only store that survives an isolated workspace/worktree being deleted. Unlike .workflow/state.json (in-run only) or .workflow/lessons.md (per-project, deleted with the workspace), this file is meant to accumulate indefinitely and be read back by Step 4 (MAX_TURNS derivation) and Step 7 (retro). Append-only: never rewrite a prior line.

project.description: Project name or path, for grouping/filtering

phase.description: Phase name within a multi-phase plan this run delivered (see SKILL.md's 'Multi-phase plans' section); null for an ordinary single-phase run. taskShape/turnsUsed/etc. below describe just this phase's slice when set, not the whole plan.

taskShape.description: Cheap, comparable descriptors of what kind of task this was — used to decide whether another run's turnsUsed is a fair comparison for MAX_TURNS derivation

diffLoc.description: Total lines added+removed across the final diff

hasTestInfra.description: Did the project already have a test runner/framework the task could use, or did verify.sh have to rely on tsc/lint/grep-only checks

supervisedTurns.description: Turns the Step 3 supervised pass took to reach a clean verify.sh

maxTurnsSet.description: The --max-turns value chosen for the Step 4 hands-off run

turnsUsed.description: num_turns actually reported by the --output-format json result

terminalReason.description: The CLI's own terminal_reason (e.g. success, max_turns, tool_use) — not the /goal stopReason enum, which is a separate semantic signal

allPassVerifiedByOrchestrator.description: Did the orchestrator (you) actually rerun verify.sh and see allPass:true, vs only trusting the nested session's self-report or a possibly-stale evidence.json

hooksFired.description: Did loop-log.sh/token-tally.sh produce any output for this run at all; null if not checked

costUsd.description: The authoritative total_cost_usd from --output-format json when available; a labeled rough estimate otherwise; null if neither exists

criteriaShapes.description: Rough counts of how verify.sh's criteria were implemented, to track the structural-grep-vs-behavioral-check balance over time

outcome.description: success_undeclared MUST be used (not 'failure') when verify.sh independently shows allPass:true but the session never reached the point of declaring the goal condition satisfied (e.g. it hit max_turns first) — conflating this with a real failure corrupts every future MAX_TURNS/retro read of this ledger.

notes.description: Free-text one-liner: what the task was, anything surprising
